## Problem to solve

What limitation or user need does this address?

## Desired behavior

Describe the change you want.

## Use case and target user

Who would use this, and in what situation?

## Constraints and non-goals

Describe constraints and anything this request should not change. Git Messages
remains a public, read-only curated reference with a stateless builder.

## Compatibility expectations

Feature parity across browser, REST, GraphQL, CLI, and OpenAPI is the default
where applicable. Route or API parity is expected only when explicitly
requested. Describe any compatibility concerns.
